db:select.doc:name: Insert application
db:select.db:sql: WITH ins AS ( INSERT INTO applications (request_id, payload_hash, correlation_id, product_code, requested_amount, requested_tenure, applicant_name, date_of_birth, identity_ref, email, monthly_income, monthly_obligations, employment_months, manifest) VALUES (:requestId, :payloadHash, CAST(:correlationId AS uuid), :productCode, :requestedAmount, :requestedTenure, :applicantName, CAST(:dateOfBirth AS date), :identityRef, :email, :monthlyIncome, :monthlyObligations, :employmentMonths, CAST(:manifest AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT (request_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING application_id, correlation_id ), ob AS ( INSERT INTO outbox (id, queue_name, payload) SELECT CAST(:messageId AS uuid), 'loan.verify.q', jsonb_build_object('messageId', CAST(:messageId AS text), 'correlationId', CAST(ins.correlation_id AS text), 'applicationId', ins.application_id, 'type', 'VERIFY_REQUESTED', 'attempt', 1, 'createdAt', CAST(:createdAt AS text)) FROM ins ), au AS ( INSERT INTO decision_audit (application_id, correlation_id, event, to_stage, source_app) SELECT ins.application_id, ins.correlation_id, 'RECEIVED', 'RECEIVED', 'loan-system-api' FROM ins ) SELECT application_id FROM ins
db:select.db:input-parameters: #[{ requestId: payload.requestId, payloadHash: payload.payloadHash, correlationId: payload.correlationId, productCode: payload.productCode, requestedAmount: payload.requestedAmount, requestedTenure: payload.requestedTenure, applicantName: payload.applicantName, dateOfBirth: payload.dateOfBirth as String, identityRef: payload.identityRef, email: payload.email, monthlyIncome: payload.monthlyIncome, monthlyObligations: payload.monthlyObligations default 0, employmentMonths: payload.employmentMonths default 0, manifest: write(payload.manifest, "application/json"), messageId: uuid(), createdAt: (now() >> "UTC") as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"} }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { applicationId: vars.appId, created: vars.created, stage: vars.stage }

db:select.doc:name: Find application
db:select.db:sql: SELECT application_id, payload_hash, stage FROM applications WHERE request_id = :requestId

set-variable.value: This request id was already used with a different payload
set-variable.doc:name: Set appErrorMessage

db:select.doc:name: Get application
db:select.db:sql: SELECT application_id, request_id, CAST(correlation_id AS text) AS correlation_id, product_code, requested_amount, requested_tenure, applicant_name, CAST(date_of_birth AS text) AS date_of_birth, identity_ref, email, monthly_income, monthly_obligations, employment_months, CAST(manifest AS text) AS manifest, stage, stage_reason, verification_round, CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM created_at) AS bigint) AS created_epoch, CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM updated_at) AS bigint) AS updated_epoch FROM applications WHERE application_id = :applicationId

db:select.doc:name: Get documents
db:select.db:sql: SELECT doc_type, file_name, status, reason, size_bytes, sha256, source_path, stored_path FROM application_documents WHERE application_id = :applicationId ORDER BY id

db:select.doc:name: Get decision
db:select.db:sql: SELECT decision, score, scorecard_version, deciding_rule, array_to_string(reason_codes, ',') AS reason_codes, requested_amount, approved_amount, approved_tenure, approved_rate_pct, instalment, affordability_ratio, reduction_reason, CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM offer_expires_at) AS bigint) AS offer_expires_epoch, CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM decided_at) AS bigint) AS decided_epoch FROM credit_decisions WHERE application_id = :applicationId

db:select.doc:name: Get rule hits
db:select.db:sql: SELECT rule_code, rule_type, input_value, weight, points, contribution, triggered FROM decision_rule_hits WHERE application_id = :applicationId ORDER BY id
